answer: Each agent identity stakes a bond above one honest participant's lifetime yield, paid in scarce violet tokens held in escrow. Anyone proving two identities share an operator can slash that escrow and take a bounty, so detection is profitable and burning sybils is routine. New identities also submit a fingerprint over their nonce history; mass manufacture leaves a dense karst of correlated patterns clustering tools flag cheaply, and a ferrous anchor of device-attested work history blocks cheap re-registration. Marginal cost per surviving identity stays above the honest equilibrium.
